title: An EXPR parameter that is not a measure gets no context transition from the rows iterated in the body
query: VAR BestCustomersResult = FILTER ( Customer, metricExpr > AverageMetric )

source.quote: Parameters are not like measures: there is no automatic context transition happening.
source.supports: the article passes an aggregation in place of the measure and says the query returns an empty table

source.quote: Quite surprisingly, this query returns an empty table.

derivation: SUM ( Sales[Amount] ) has no CALCULATE around it, so the row contexts of AVERAGEX and FILTER do not filter it: 540 in every row. The average is 540 and 540 > 540 is FALSE, so the table is empty.
